indicator.name: Households owning a car
indicator.description: Percentage of conventional households owning a car in KNBS 2019 KPHC Volume IV Table 2.36.
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published directly for all 47 counties. This is household car ownership, not an administrative vehicle-registration count or vehicles per capita. It is non-directional and excluded from ranking. No combined vehicle-ownership total is inferred.

observations.source_table: Table 2.36 — Percentage Distribution of Conventional Households by Ownership of Selected Household Assets by Area of Residence, County and Sub County
observations.notes: Direct KNBS 2019 KPHC Table 2.36 percentage of conventional households owning a car. This is not a registered-vehicle count, NTSA registration location, vehicle stock or per-capita vehicle rate. The 47-county values are independently cross-checked against the KPHC-derived PLOS ONE Table 1. No ownership columns are summed into a synthetic total.
